svg.aria-label: Two panels. Panel A, eleven files and a tar of five media files compressed whole with gzip -9, zstd 19, xz -9 and brotli 11, saving as a percentage of the file, negative when it grew: JPEG, Pillow q90, 159,419 bytes: gzip -9 minus 0.017%, zstd 19 minus 0.009%, xz -9 minus 0.043%, brotli 11 minus 0.003%; PNG, Kodak kodim05, 785,610 bytes: gzip -9 minus 0.033%, zstd 19 minus 0.003%, xz -9 minus 0.012%, brotli 11 grew by 5 bytes; Opus, 96 kb/s, 636,816 bytes: gzip -9 minus 0.023%, zstd 19 minus 0.004%, xz -9 minus 0.014%, brotli 11 grew by 5 bytes; .zip, DEFLATE 6, 1,127,914 bytes: gzip -9 minus 0.021%, zstd 19 minus 0.003%, xz -9 minus 0.010%, brotli 11 grew by 5 bytes; .tar.gz, gzip -6, 1,127,742 bytes: gzip -9 minus 0.019%, zstd 19 minus 0.003%, xz -9 minus 0.010%, brotli 11 grew by 5 bytes; MP4, SVT-AV1 CRF 35, 2,106,647 bytes: gzip -9 0.026%, zstd 19 0.057%, xz -9 0.029%, brotli 11 grew by 8 bytes; MP4, x264 CRF 23, 3,761,614 bytes: gzip -9 0.048%, zstd 19 0.069%, xz -9 0.036%, brotli 11 grew by 13 bytes; tar of five media files, 10,014,720 bytes: zstd 19 0.441%, xz -9 0.407%; FLAC, level 8, 4,663,924 bytes: gzip -9 0.750%, zstd 19 0.761%, xz -9 0.728%, brotli 11 0.391%; PNG, xo-space screenshot, 390,623 bytes: gzip -9 0.837%, zstd 19 1.168%, xz -9 0.901%, brotli 11 1.117%; AAC 128 kb/s, .m4a, 849,338 bytes: gzip -9 1.467%, zstd 19 1.779%, xz -9 1.183%, brotli 11 1.988%; JPEG, og.jpg, 66,400 bytes: gzip -9 3.399%, zstd 19 4.182%, xz -9 3.904%, brotli 11 4.658%. Panel B, the inner coding re-done losslessly, saving on a scale from 0 to 45 percent: .zip to tar, xz -9 41.144% (best wrapped grew by 5 bytes); .tar.gz to tar, xz -9 41.135% (best wrapped grew by 5 bytes); screenshot, oxipng -o 4 40.111% (best wrapped 1.168%); Kodak PNG to JPEG XL 38.257% (best wrapped grew by 5 bytes); screenshot to JPEG XL 37.759% (best wrapped 1.168%); og.jpg to JPEG XL 32.756% (best wrapped 4.658%); Pillow JPEG to JPEG XL 13.209% (best wrapped minus 0.003%); Kodak PNG, oxipng -o 4 3.915% (best wrapped grew by 5 bytes). Wrapping never saved more than 4.658 percent; re-coding saved up to 41.144 percent.
svg.text: B · RE-CODED LOSSLESSLY · SAVING, % OF THE ORIGINAL
JPEG XL: -d 0 -e 9 from a PNG; --lossless_jpeg=1 from a JPEG, which djxl rebuilt bit for bit.
